notes.title: New game, new button
notes.notes:
¡Hi everyone!

For those who may not know, I'm making a new game, The Hookmarine, a rage game created to test your patience in which you have to move a toxic barrel using a submarine and a hook.

To celebrate the release of the demo, I've decided to give every player of THE BUTTON a new color with those particle effects that you love.

I'll be very grateful if you try the demo of The Hookmarine and if you add it to your wishlist.

Thanks for all the support you've giving me, and if you play I hope you enjoy my new little game :)

notes.title: Happy holidays!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

In this happy season, I bring you gifts. With this update I've added a new button color for free. I hope you like it.

Thanks for playing my silly game, this year have been a roller coaster of emotions and seeing people pressing this dumb button made me very happy.

I wish you all a happy holiday season and a great new year :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659080/782b8aa60b6df0c5152179b056cca20b1fc1b7e3.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I hope your button pressing is going well. Either way, it now can go better with the Spooky Button, a Halloween themed color and effect for your button.

You can purchase it now and, as always, enable it from the settings menu.

I hope you like it and Happy Halloween to everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659080/acd1bc24b6147b53c73789edda0da3629dc7d085.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Small Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Some days ago a bug vas introduced where the max score sometimes was not updated. Being the solely purpose of the game, that was very important to fix.

It should be working as intended with this update.

Also, I used this patch to add two new colors, a brown and a magenta. I hope you like them.

notes.title: Who will be the first to get 50 points?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

There's lots of people playing THE BUTTON right now. 
Lots of people trying to be THE FIRST on the leaderboards.

Ok.

The first person to LEGALLY achieve 50 points (yes, I know if you cheat) will be immortalized in the game with a message:

- WINNER NAME* was the first person to achieve 50 points.

Good Luck.

[i]*If the name contains inappropriate language, I'll ask for a more appropriate name to show ingame.[/i]
